description: Create a reference to a secret stored in AWS Secrets Manager, Azure Key Vault, or HashiCorp Vault. Authentication credentials are sent to Portkey and exposed to this MCP transcript; use short-lived or workload identity modes when possible. Returns the new UUID and slug, never the resolved external secret.

allow_all_workspaces.description: Whether every workspace may use this reference; defaults to true and cannot be true with allowed_workspaces

allowed_workspaces.description: Workspace UUIDs or slugs allowed to use this reference; omit when allow_all_workspaces is true

aws_access_key_id.description: AWS access key ID; required when aws_auth_type is accessKey

aws_auth_type.description: Use an AWS access key ID and secret access key

aws_region.description: AWS region containing the secret, for example us-east-1

aws_secret_access_key.description: AWS secret access key; required when aws_auth_type is accessKey and exposed to the MCP transcript

aws_auth_type.description: Assume the specified AWS IAM role

aws_external_id.description: Optional external ID required by the target IAM role

aws_region.description: AWS region containing the secret, for example us-east-1

aws_role_arn.description: IAM role ARN to assume; required when aws_auth_type is assumedRole

aws_auth_type.description: Use the AWS workload or service role available at runtime

aws_region.description: Optional AWS region containing the secret, for example us-east-1

azure_auth_mode.description: Authenticate with a Microsoft Entra application client secret

azure_entra_client_id.description: Microsoft Entra application client ID; required for entra authentication

azure_entra_client_secret.description: Microsoft Entra client secret; required for entra authentication and exposed to the MCP transcript

azure_entra_tenant_id.description: Microsoft Entra tenant ID; required for entra authentication

azure_vault_url.description: Azure Key Vault URL, for example https://example.vault.azure.net

azure_auth_mode.description: Authenticate with an Azure managed identity

azure_managed_client_id.description: Optional client ID of a user-assigned managed identity; omit for the system-assigned identity

azure_vault_url.description: Azure Key Vault URL, for example https://example.vault.azure.net

azure_auth_mode.description: Use Azure's default runtime credential chain

azure_vault_url.description: Azure Key Vault URL, for example https://example.vault.azure.net

vault_addr.description: Base URL of the HashiCorp Vault server

vault_auth_type.description: Authenticate to HashiCorp Vault with a token

vault_token.description: HashiCorp Vault token; required for token authentication and exposed to the MCP transcript

vault_addr.description: Base URL of the HashiCorp Vault server

vault_auth_type.description: Authenticate to HashiCorp Vault with AppRole credentials

vault_role_id.description: HashiCorp Vault AppRole role ID; required for approle authentication

vault_secret_id.description: HashiCorp Vault AppRole secret ID; required for approle authentication and exposed to the MCP transcript

vault_addr.description: Base URL of the HashiCorp Vault server

vault_auth_type.description: Authenticate to HashiCorp Vault with a Kubernetes service account

vault_role.description: HashiCorp Vault Kubernetes auth role name

auth_config.description: Choose exactly one documented authentication shape matching manager_type. Credentials are sent to Portkey and visible in the MCP transcript; prefer workload identity or short-lived credentials when available.

description.description: Optional description; use null to leave it empty

manager_type.description: External secret manager: aws_sm for AWS Secrets Manager, azure_kv for Azure Key Vault, or hashicorp_vault for HashiCorp Vault; must match the auth_config field family

organisation_id.description: Organisation UUID; required when the MCP server is not authenticated with a Portkey API key

secret_key.description: Optional key within a structured external secret; null uses the whole secret value

secret_path.description: Path of the secret in the external secret manager

slug.description: Optional stable slug containing only letters, numbers, underscores, or hyphens; Portkey generates one when omitted

anyOf.description: Tag filters or metadata as string key-value pairs

tags.description: Optional string key-value tags for filtering and organization

name: create_secret_reference

data.description: Structured success payload when ok is true

error.description: Structured error payload when ok is false

ok.description: Whether the tool call succeeded and returned structured data
